He calls it 'great news for Micron stock investors,' but the digest records no buy, hold or sell direction, so the entry is logged as UNCERTAIN rather than as a call. This follows Part 1 of the same series, which also deferred any new verdict to Part 4 (still members-only at the time of the digest). No explicit calls in this one.
